mapper.select: SELECT * FROM RPT_FREE_REPORT_BATCH WHERE REPORT_NAME = #{reportName} ORDER BY IMPORT_TIME DESC
SELECT * FROM RPT_FREE_REPORT_BATCH WHERE FILE_NAME = #{fileName} ORDER BY IMPORT_TIME DESC

SELECT b.* FROM RPT_FREE_REPORT_BATCH b
AND (b.REPORT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.FILE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND b.IMPORT_TIME >= #{dateFrom} AND b.IMPORT_TIME < #{dateTo} AND b.STATUS <> 'DISABLED'
ORDER BY b.IMPORT_TIME DESC LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE RPT_FREE_REPORT_BATCH SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_TIME = NOW() WHERE ID = #{batchId}
